"re-performance of the non-conforming Services, repair or replacement of the non-conforming portion of the Site, or a refund of the fees paid"

reasons: Preferred level fails: the conformance warranty is diluted to "in all material respects" and runs for only ninety (90) days, with no 12-month software/deliverable conformance period.

No express services warranty period measured from performance or completion; the single 90-day period is measured from written acceptance of the Site, so neither the preferred 90-day services period nor the fallback 30-day services period is stated.
Remedy set adds "re-performance" and an "at HDI's option" election beyond the playbook's repair/replace/refund set, and refund is limited to "fees paid" for non-conforming Services only.

Minimality fails: the insertion carries weakening extras ("in all material respects", "consistent with industry standards", vendor-elected re-performance) that are not needed to complete the preferred level.

Fix: state that the Site and any software will conform to the documentation for twelve (12) months and that Services will conform/be performed to standard for ninety (90) days following performance, delete "in all material respects" and the re-performance option.
